record_purpose: Bind the R4 enforcement receipt without putting that receipt's SHA-256 inside itself. This file is not a candidate gate map.

source.revision_role: committed baseline containing the first review-repair pass
source.review_repair_state: files_changed names the complete dirty set. files_hashed names the non-receipt implementation/documentation files plus the bound source receipt; this binding receipt deliberately excludes its own bytes. The follow-up commit preserves this file, completing the chain.

scope: This file binds review-repair source bytes only. It records no check result, execution evidence, or candidate approval.
non_claims: This binding does not verify a live candidate, artifact, appcast, gate receipt, packaging run, or release.
This file cannot contain its own SHA-256; its bytes are bound by the follow-up commit rather than by a self-entry.
